notes.title: Bug fix & Debug mode: ON
notes.content:
Acievement bug fixed.
Default debug mode: ON.
If you want off the debug mode, delete ultradebugger.txt in save folder.

notes.title: How to change character voice.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045195/c005a2617b0c2bf31362370a33d1451e52e1fce7.png[/img]
<Easy Voice Change System>
This game has E.V.C.S.
All character voice files are ogg audio in voice folder.
Voice number is for each text number in text folder.

notes.title: How to translate message text language.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045195/46212dfa52242802c2511648978a89461247cd38.png[/img]
<Easy Translation System>
This game has E.T.S.
All character messages are written in text files.
You can easily translate to your language.
